Vendored DBC snapshots for the pit-diag conformance tests.

Both files are READ-ONLY copies of another repo's generated DBC. They
exist so the hardcoded decoders can be checked against the wire without
taking a runtime DBC dependency. Never hand-edit them: re-copy from the
upstream repo instead, so the snapshot always equals something that was
actually generated.


== ams.dbc ==========================================================

Source of truth: isc-fs/IFS08-CE-AMS docs/dbc/ams.dbc (generated by
tools/gen_dbc.py on that repo). Used by tests/pitdiag_dbc_conformance.rs
to assert the hardcoded decoder layout still matches the AMS wire
definition.

Vendored from branch: dev
Commit:  f03b3b61e81085caa060d2325e0a342219aa5bf0
Date:    2026-06-02T22:27:30Z

To refresh: re-copy docs/dbc/ams.dbc from the AMS repo and update this
file's commit/date. If the conformance test then fails, the AMS wire
changed — reconcile src/pit_diag/mod.rs before shipping.


== ecu.dbc ==========================================================

Source of truth: isc-fs/IFS08-CE-ECU docs/dbc/ecu.dbc, generated from
the CAN DSL (Core/Inc/can/messages/*.def) by tools/dbc_dump.cpp and
kept current by that repo's dbcinator bot, which regenerates and
force-pushes it on every PR. Used by tests/ecu_dbc_conformance.rs.

Vendored from branch: dev
Commit:  a8165564a87e3202d50b8f63fba2d22ca8819910
Date:    2026-07-22T01:56:41+02:00

Vendor from the ECU's **dev** branch only — dev is the merged wire
contract. Vendoring from a feature branch would pin this decoder to a
layout that is still under review and may move before it lands.

As of this snapshot the ECU has an unmerged branch (fix/inv-fault-off-word)
adding 0x708 PitDiag_inv_faults — the W90 L1/L2 fault-layer bitmasks.
That frame is deliberately NOT in this snapshot and NOT decoded. When it
merges to dev, re-vendor: ecu_dbc_conformance.rs will fail on the
PitDiag_* message set, which is the intended signal to add the decoder
(and bump ECU_EXPECTED_FRAMES_PER_SCAN to 8, since 0x708 is cyclic at
100 ms).

To refresh: re-copy docs/dbc/ecu.dbc from the ECU repo's dev branch and
update this file's commit/date. If the conformance test then fails, the
ECU wire changed — reconcile src/pit_diag/ecu.rs *and* the CLI/Studio
surfaces that carry the field before shipping. Six drifts accumulated
silently before this test existed (see the test's module docs).
